note: The Centrale Bank van Aruba, which issues the florin, states on its page The Aruban florin that the florin is pegged to the US dollar at US$1.00 = Afl. 1.79; read 2026-10-30.

sources.title: The Aruban florin (Centrale Bank van Aruba)
sources.said: the florin, which is pegged to the U.S. dollar at $1.00 = Afl. 1.79, became the official currency of the island ... The Centrale Bank van Aruba (CBA) was entrusted with the responsibility for the issuance of the florin banknotes
